criteria: Start with all CFS cloud-safe public parcel rows with a parcel identifier.
Filter to parcels with gross acreage greater than or equal to 100 acres.
Require usable CFS planning, transportation, and Investment evidence.
Initial screen requires transportation evidence, environmental band other than High Verification Need, and sewer-proximity proxy of Adjacent, Near, or Moderate.
Manual review uses the 100-point CASE-1 analyst screen and includes the required active parcel without forcing rank.

formula_framework: Developable acres x modeled density = estimated lots.
Estimated lots x finished-lot value = gross development revenue.

Gross development revenue minus horizontal development cost, off-site infrastructure, soft costs, contingency, selling costs, financing or carry allowance, and required developer margin = preliminary maximum supportable land price.
Costs are intended to be either per lot, fixed allowances, or percentages as specified by input.
Developer margin is applied to gross development revenue in the proposed first model.
Financing is simplified as a carry allowance; no IRR or discounting is included in the first review model.

sensitivity_design.purpose: Tests the two assumptions most likely to move residual support materially.
Tests site-yield uncertainty before final lot count is approved.
Optional third table if the user wants to isolate infrastructure and timing risk.

case_3a_2_underwriting_consistency_revie.status: Diagnostic review only - no final model, workbook, valuation, or acquisition recommendation
case_3a_2_underwriting_consistency_revie.executive_finding: The current proposed assumptions are internally conservative but not financially viable as a residual land-value setup. All three scenarios produce negative pre-land residuals before selling and carry costs. After proposed selling and carry conventions, no scenario supports the proposed horizontal cost at the proposed finished-lot value.

formula_conventions.soft_costs: Calculated on horizontal development cost plus fixed off-site infrastructure costs.
formula_conventions.contingency: Calculated on horizontal development cost, fixed off-site infrastructure costs, and soft costs.
formula_conventions.developer_margin: Calculated as a percentage of gross lot-sale revenue.
formula_conventions.selling_costs: Proposed as a percentage of gross lot-sale revenue; not included in the original current scenario list.
formula_conventions.financing_and_carry: Simplified percentage allowance on horizontal, fixed off-site, soft-cost, and contingency subtotal; no IRR or discounted cash-flow timing in CASE-3A.2.

horizontal_cost_scope.definition: Horizontal development cost per lot is treated as internal site-development cost only.
excluded_cost_components: Pump station or special utility facility
horizontal_cost_scope.compatibility_status: Definition required before any cost benchmark can be used.
horizontal_cost_scope.potential_double_counting: The prior Other off-site or pump-station allowance can overlap with the sewer/special-utility allowance. Keep it blank or separated until utility design confirms a distinct facility.

break_even_thresholds.interpretation: At the proposed lot value, no positive density or fixed off-site allowance resolves the scenario because per-lot economics are already negative.
At the proposed lot value, no positive density resolves the scenario after selling/carry because horizontal cost is too high relative to revenue.
The upside is closest, but it still fails after selling/carry at the proposed lot value and horizontal cost.
